article_content: 'On Christmas Day 2013, a premature baby girl named Lailani Casara entered the world under tragic circumstances.  Her teenage mother, Eva Mae Casara, was fatally shot during a botched robbery, necessitating an emergency C-section at just 25 weeks of pregnancy. Lailani, weighing a mere 1 pound 10 ounces at birth, was given a slim chance of survival. However, after five months of intensive care at Advocate Christ Medical Center in Chicago, she defied the odds.  Lailani is now home, breathing on her own, under the loving care of her great-grandmother, Fannie Casara, and her aunt. While she still requires supplemental oxygen and a feeding tube, Lailani is making remarkable progress, mimicking facial expressions and reaching for toys.  The family shares stories of Eva Mae with Lailani, keeping her mother's memory alive.  Eva Mae's boyfriend, 16-year-old Anthony Lee, and his two half-brothers, Diante Coakley, 21, and Darius D. Marshall, 19, are currently in jail awaiting trial for their involvement in the robbery and shooting that led to Eva Mae's death. The family remembers Eva Mae as a young woman who had aspirations of becoming a doctor and was excited about the prospect of having a daughter. They are now focused on providing Lailani with a 'normal, beautiful life,' far removed from the violence that marked her entrance into the world.'
translated_content: 'Na Božić 2013. godine, prevremeno rođena devojčica po imenu Lailani Casara došla je na svet pod tragičnim okolnostima. Njena majka tinejdžerka, Eva Mae Casara, smrtno je stradala u neuspelom pokušaju pljačke, što je zahtevalo hitan carski rez u samo 25. nedelji trudnoće. Lailani, teška svega 700 grama po rođenju, imala je male šanse za preživljavanje. Međutim, nakon pet meseci intenzivne nege u Medicinskom centru Advocate Christ u Čikagu, prkosila je svim izgledima. Lailani je sada kod kuće, diše samostalno, pod ljubavnom brigom svoje prabake, Fannie Casara, i tetke. Iako joj je i dalje potreban dodatni kiseonik i hranjenje putem sonde, Lailani napreduje neverovatno, imitirajući izraze lica i posežući za igračkama. Porodica deli priče o Evi Mae sa Lailani, održavajući uspomenu na njenu majku živom. Evin dečko, 16-godišnji Anthony Lee, i njegova dva polubrata, Diante Coakley (21) i Darius D. Marshall (19), trenutno su u zatvoru čekajući suđenje zbog umešanosti u pljačku i pucnjavu koja je dovela do Evine smrti. Porodica pamti Evu Mae kao mladu ženu koja je težila da postane doktorka i bila je uzbuđena zbog toga što će dobiti ćerku. Sada su usredsređeni na to da Lailani pruže 'normalan, lep život', daleko od nasilja koje je obeležilo njen dolazak na svet.'

article_content: 'A steppe eagle, aptly named Storm, unexpectedly visited the living room of retired teacher Wendy Morrell in Poole, Dorset.  The eagle entered through open patio doors, landing on a display cabinet and creating a slight commotion by knocking over some ornaments.  Ms. Morrell and her friend, Karen Ruddlesden, were initially startled by the large bird's sudden appearance.  They contacted Wessex Bird of Prey Rescue after unsuccessful attempts to coax the eagle out with ham.  An expert from the rescue center successfully retrieved Storm using a dead chick as a lure. The eagle's owner, falconer James Moore, was training Storm to ward off seagulls at a nearby landfill site. Storm had gone missing three days earlier after being frightened by a loud noise and breaking free from its tethers. Mr. Moore expressed relief at Storm's safe return and apologized to Ms. Morrell for the disruption.'
translated_content: 'Stepski orao, prikladno nazvan Oluja, neočekivano je posetio dnevnu sobu penzionisane nastavnice Vendi Morel u Pulu, u Dorsetu.  Orao je ušao kroz otvorena vrata terase, sleteo na vitrinu i izazvao malu pometnju oborivši neke ukrase.  Gospođa Morel i njena prijateljica, Karen Radlsden, bile su u početku iznenađene iznenadnom pojavom velike ptice.  Kontaktirale su spasilački centar za ptice grabljivice Veseks nakon neuspešnih pokušaja da namame orla napolje šunkom.  Stručnjak iz spasilačkog centra uspešno je vratio Oluju koristeći mrtvo pile kao mamac.  Vlasnik orla, sokolar Džejms Mur, trenirao je Oluju da rastera galebove na obližnjoj deponiji.  Oluja je nestala tri dana ranije nakon što se uplašila glasnog praska i oslobodila se vezova.  Gospodin Mur je izrazio olakšanje zbog bezbednog povratka Oluje i izvinio se gospođi Morel zbog prekida.'

article_content: 'Prime Minister David Cameron announced his commitment to replacing the Human Rights Act with a British Bill of Rights. He expressed criticism of European human rights judges, emphasizing the UK Parliament's authority to create its own laws.  Furthermore, he addressed concerns about immigration from within the European Union, particularly the impact on the British welfare system.  Cameron also highlighted past achievements such as reducing the European Union budget and withdrawing from EU bailout programs.  Proposed reforms include granting increased authority to the British Supreme Court and potentially enabling Members of Parliament to overrule certain rulings from the European Court of Human Rights.  In addition, Cameron commended Home Secretary Theresa May's work in limiting non-EU immigration and closing down fraudulent educational institutions. He also expressed his disapproval of human rights rulings that have prevented the deportation of suspected terrorists.'
translated_content: 'Premijer David Cameron najavio je svoju posvećenost zameni Zakona o ljudskim pravima britanskim Zakonom o pravima. Izrazio je kritiku prema evropskim sudijama za ljudska prava, naglašavajući autoritet britanskog parlamenta da kreira sopstvene zakone.  Pored toga, bavio se zabrinutošću zbog imigracije iz Evropske unije, posebno uticajem na britanski sistem socijalne zaštite. Kameron je takođe istakao prošla dostignuća poput smanjenja budžeta Evropske unije i povlačenja iz programa pomoći EU. Predložene reforme uključuju davanje većeg autoriteta Vrhovnom sudu Velike Britanije i potencijalno omogućavanje članovima parlamenta da ponište određene presude Evropskog suda za ljudska prava. Pored toga, Cameron je pohvalio rad ministarke unutrašnjih poslova Therese May u ograničavanju imigracije izvan EU i zatvaranju lažnih obrazovnih institucija.  Takođe je izrazio neodobravanje presuda o ljudskim pravima koje su sprečile deportaciju osumnjičenih za terorizam.'
